title: Spanish opposition criticised for AI video of Pedro Sánchez in Morocco shirt
summary_full: People’s party alters video of PM putting on Lamine Yamal’s Spain shirt in latest contentious use of AI in election raceSpanning 17 seconds, the campaign video showed the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, speaking to the camera as he put on the jersey of the national football team. “Because this is what Spain is: a pluralistic and diverse country,” he said as he turned to reveal the number 19 on his back – the shirt number of the star player Lamine Yamal.One day later, the opposition People’s party (PP) came under fire after it used AI to manipulate the same video, making it falsely appear as if Sánchez had put on the shirt of the Moroccan national team.
